draft.title: What environmental sustainability means
card: Environmental sustainability means meeting the needs of people today without leaving future generations worse off. It looks at how resources are used and how much damage is done to the environment.
The idea is about the future as well as the present. Using a resource faster than nature can replace it, or causing harm that lasts, reduces what later generations can use.
Sustainability is tracked with measures. Emissions per person show how much greenhouse gas each person in a country produces, on average.
Land use and water use show how much land is cleared or farmed and how much water is taken. A rise in these over time, without time for recovery, is a sign that use may not be sustainable.
draft.remember: Sustainable means meeting today's needs without leaving later generations with less.

a.q: Which situation best shows a lack of environmental sustainability?
opts: A town drains its only water source faster than it refills
A town uses more water this year than it did ten years ago
A town sets a price on the water its households use
A town has more people than it had ten years ago
a.why: Draining water faster than it refills leaves less for later generations, so it is not sustainable. Using more water than before is not enough on its own, because the supply may recover as fast as it is used.
a.clue: Look for use that leaves less for people in the future.

b.q: Country X's emissions per person have fallen over ten years, but its water use has risen sharply and its water sources are not refilling. What can be said about its sustainability?
opts: Lower emissions are a good sign, but water use is a concern
It is sustainable, because emissions per person are falling
It is unsustainable, because emissions are a poor measure
Nothing can be said, because the measures differ in kind
b.why: Sustainability is tracked with several measures. Falling emissions per person is a good sign, but water use that outpaces refilling leaves less for later generations. The second option is wrong because one good measure does not settle the whole picture.
b.clue: Check every measure, not just the one that looks good.
